gameTitle: Infinite Echoes in The Infinite Abyss
subtitle: THE INFINITE ABYSS ENCYCLOPEDIA
dataStatus: Beta revision — player-facing database details and version history are being refined. Database entries are subject to change.

versionHistory.changes: Refined skill cards and cooldown sorting; improved Timing & Action layout; moved Action Commands to the end of the main navigation; added passive armor filtering; refined accessibility tooltip sizing.

Fixed detail-term tooltips; reorganized navigation; combined skill Timing & Action details for cleaner layouts; restored reliable enemy and catalog card navigation; refined accessibility tooltip sizing and positioning.

Refined tooltip sizing and hover cues; simplified Unique Only guidance; added Action Commands reference and skill action-command details; documented Danger and Critical HP conditions; tightened accessibility control sizing.

Improved tooltip layout; removed engine-specific wording from public terminology; corrected Invocation Speed guidance; added a public Glossary; moved unique-equipment requirement text into the Unique Only tooltip.

Added clickable skill links with hover previews for equipment effects; added contextual RPG Maker tooltips to metadata labels and values; added skill cooldown and warm-up details; simplified equipment requirement notes into player-facing requirement information.

Fixed a critical missing catalog-rendering function that caused the public site to load only its background with no content. Restored cards, list rendering, sorting, filters, weapon artwork mapping, and added a visible load-error message for missing data files.
Added a dedicated Version History page; made 0.0.4E and prior revisions directly accessible; improved note parsing for player-facing equipment conditions; removed player-facing database ID fields.
Reorganized skill and item metadata into compact groups; added System.json names; improved equipment note details; corrected rate-based effect wording; color-coded detail parameters.
Expanded player-facing item, weapon, armor, and skill details; corrected trait/effect summaries; removed icon IDs and redundant tier labels; added color-coded detail parameters.
Navigation polish, equipment stat previews, effect summaries, custom tooltips, and scroll reset.
Fixed entry routing and Recently Cataloged links; normalized database ID matching.

Beta revision: restored bottom-left spoiler controls, added text-size controls, global header search, enemy previous/next navigation, corrected equipment tier mapping, equipment parameters, item categories, player skill categories, and playable character portraits.
Reworked navigation, detail pages, sorting, enemy information, social links, and data filtering.
Added the larger RPG Maker database import and enemy encounter detection.
